profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at General Motors
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer and embedded-systems designer.

High-reliability Linux systems for automotive, medical, and industrial applications. Kernel and bootloader development, and SOC/board bringup. Embedded Linux system design including hardware development, flash partition layout, firmware update mechanisms, and related concerns.

System software for POSIX systems. C and C++ for high-performance daemons, and Python for rapid development. Shell-scripts for use on embedded designs with space / licensing constraints.

UNIX/Linux scripting and build automation, including FPGA / EDA toolchains. Good with TCL for EDA tool automation, GNU Make for Buildroot and general automation, GNU Autotools for open-source work, and CMake and Scons for larger build systems.

Bare-metal programming for application processors and microcontrollers. Includes OS drivers for Linux, bootloaders with U-boot, and RTOS work with FreeRTOS. 

Hardware engineering background with experience in schematic capture and PCB layout, high-reliability circuit design, and design for manufacturing. System Verilog / RTL for FPGAs and ASICs.

Skills:
- Build automation
- Embedded Linux with Yocto/OpenEmbedded
- Embedded Linux with Buildroot
- POSIX operating system standards
- Programming for Linux with Python, C++, C, Bash / POSIX shell, and TCL
- Hardware and software architecture
- Hardware design and hardware/software codesign
- Standalone FPGA systems with System Verilog
- Embedded CPU architecture within the Xilinx Vivado ecosystem.
- Bare-metal software development in C and C++
- System software C, C++, and Python.
- Scripted build automation with Make, CMake, and SCons.
- Documentation / technical writing.
- SPICE circuit simulation using LTSPICE.
- Analog circuit design.
- Circuit schematic capture in ORCAD.
- PCB design and layout in ORCAD.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Automation · Build Automation · System Architecture · Linux

positions.title: FPGA Engineer III
positions.description:
Embedded systems and FPGA designer.

Developer of firmware for high-performance surgical cameras. Programming in Verilog for FPGA-based targets, and in C for embedded systems. Design of software build systems for use in challenging build environments, and support of production Linux build servers.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer II
positions.description:
Expansion of duties and responsibilities from previous position.

Designed and developed underwater acoustic hardware including hydrophone monitors, class-D power amplifiers for electro-acoustic transducers, and fiber optic transmission of data back to shore. Designed and developed shore-side controllers and communications gear. Designed and wrote FPGA firmware to perform real-time control and DSP functions.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer
positions.description: Electronics Engineer with emphasis in embedded systems design, digital signal processing, and underwater acoustics. Worked on a 200+ node underwater beacon system for use in submarine training maneuvers.

positions.title: Operations / Component engineer
positions.description: Converted 4 complete product lines to RoHS compliant components, and supported replacement selection for EOL/obsolescence issues. Located over 800 pin-compatible replacements for a variety of electronic components including passive components, transistors, op-amps, and other miscellaneous parts. Advised 'closest' replacements and workarounds for components with no compatible replacements.
